newsitem.title: UK: US STOCKS MIXED IN LONDON, BOEING FIRMS.
newsitem.headline: US STOCKS MIXED IN LONDON, BOEING FIRMS.

text.p: Shares in Boeing Co rose in London on Friday amid growing hopes the U.S. aerospace giant will win a $3 billion contract with India, dealers said.
In otherwise dull and thin trading, Boeing shares rose $1/4 in London, after rising $13/16 to $59-1/16 in New York on Thursday.
"The talk has been around for a while, but now the view is that Boeing will get the contract," said one dealer. "It's really the only (stock) we've seen any interest in."

Shares in Apple Computer Inc edged up $3/16 in London as optimism about Microsoft Corp's investment in the troubled computer maker announced earlier this week continued to draw interest, the said. The trade in Apple, however, was light, they added.
In other trading, shares in Chrysler Corp and Ford Motor Co each slipped $1/8 in thin trade.
Shares in Intel Corp and Philip Morris Cos Inc, which usually are relatively active in Europe, were static at New York's closing levels, they said.
Dealers were looking for a flat to lower open on Wall Street, where the Dow lost 71.31 points to 8,188.0 amid rising bond yields on Thursday.
On Globex, September S&P 500 futures were down 2.20 points to 953.93 at 1021 GMT, and September long bond futures were off 9/32 to 113-30/32.
